propositions: 12 ambient config reads flagged as below-seam in reconciler JIRA adapter files must be routed through owned resolvers in config.py to move the composition boundary above the credential surface.

11 of 12 reads (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT, acli timeout, datacenter settings, rich_text cutover clients, wiki_render pandoc timeout) must delegate to owned live-per-call resolvers, with signatures and behavior (env-over-file precedence, fail-loud, ImportError degrade) unchanged.
1 read (REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE) must be owned in-place via # read-via: marker instead of delegating to an owned resolver.
All 12 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py and check_config_ownership.py must pass with no path-glob exceptions.
Secret credentials (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT) must remain as owner=credential reads in-boundary; the cut affects only composition reads.

Live-per-call resolution semantics must be preserved so env overrides mid-pass are observed after the cut, and all behavioral regressions (insecure URL fail-loud, DC fail-loud, acli timeout clamp, ImportError→default degrade) must pass held-out oracle tests.
